name: Germany

mandates.notes: Applies to public procurement contracts above EU thresholds.

mandates.thresholdNote: All companies must be able to accept EN 16931-compliant e-invoices from this date.
Businesses with turnover above EUR 800,000 must issue e-invoices from this date.
All businesses must issue e-invoices from this date. Paper and non-EN-16931 EDI invoices remain allowed with the buyer's consent until each respective deadline.

extraFieldsBeyondEN16931: Leitweg-ID — a routing identifier required on invoices addressed to German public-sector recipients (carried as BT-10/buyerReference in this project's model).
